title: Personal Checking: The Private Client Checking Entry Comparison on Conversion
content:
## Decision rule

For an owner's request to convert a Personal Checking account to Private Client Checking, the combined deposit balance measured for that request is the relationship balance on which the Private Client entry gate is tested, and the entry floor applied is 250000.00 USD.

- When every standing requirement of the conversion holds and that balance is **at or above 250000.00 USD**, the tier recorded for the account is `Private Client Checking`.
- When the balance is **below 250000.00 USD**, the conversion is not made: the account stays in its present tier and nothing is written.

The outcome is a tier name, so no rounding arises.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical balances)

| Standing requirements | Measured balance (USD) | Tier afterwards |
|---|---|---|
| all hold | 250000.00 | Private Client Checking |
| all hold | 249999.99 | unchanged; nothing written |
| all hold | 310000.00 | Private Client Checking |
| one fails | 310000.00 | unchanged; nothing written |

## Point of judgement

Being exactly at the floor qualifies, because the comparison is "at or above".
